cv:
ACADEMIC PROFILE
Interdisciplinary academic with over fifteen years of university teaching and research spanning applied physics, data science, and artificial intelligence. Research focuses on machine learning for health and human movement, generative AI and retrieval-augmented architectures, IoT-enabled sustainable systems, and photonic crystal optics. Principal Investigator on funded research and multi-institution collaborations across the UAE, Europe, and Africa. Fellow of the Higher Education Academy with extensive curriculum development and academic leadership experience, including course system leadership across seventeen campuses and programme development to national accreditation standards. Active peer reviewer for IEEE and Elsevier journals, and author of a forthcoming textbook with CRC Press (Taylor & Francis).
RESEARCH INTERESTS
1. Machine learning and deep learning for health: precision dermatology, genotype–phenotype modeling, medical image classification
1. Generative AI and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures; explainable and privacy-preserving AI
1. Wearable sensors and human movement analysis for rehabilitation; on-device and edge inference
1. IoT-enabled sustainable systems: smart campuses, predictive maintenance, solar energy monitoring
1. Nonlinear optics and photonic crystals; computational electromagnetics (FDTD, Monte Carlo)

161 citations | h-index 8 | i10-index 7 (Google Scholar, retrieved August 2026; 127 citations since 2021)
